manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the coffee-box with orange circle and place left of the blue bell with glossy finish

Task description: Place the light-colored coffee box with an orange circle on its front, currently near the table middle, immediately to the left of the glossy blue bell at the front right. They are currently offset front to back; the goal is to make them nearly side by side.

Success criteria: Place the coffee box beside the blue bell on its left, approximately aligned front to back with a moderate gap, neither too close nor too far apart. Release the coffee box with both grippers open.

## Execution tips

- Prefer two opposite flat outer box walls, placing pads on their middle areas away from the top edge and corners. Open slightly wider than the grasp width to reduce slipping from edge or corner grasps.
- Confirm the fingers actually straddle the box wall with sufficient pad contact before closing. If there is only visual overlap, adjust the view or gripper position to avoid pushing the box over from one side.
- Near the bell, leave clearance for the box and for the finger on the bell-facing side. If the box needs turning, adjust it in a more open area to reduce the risk of sweeping into the bell.
- Before releasing, let the bottom of the box rest on the table, then open and withdraw the fingers. Avoid dropping or tipping it or moving it toward the bell with the fingers.
